description.value: Rainbow Road Aquatic Centre is a public swimming facility on Salt Spring Island, operated by SSIPARC (Salt Spring Island Parks, Arts, Recreation & Culture) as a service of the Capital Regional District. The centre offers drop-in aquatic programs and scheduled swim sessions for island residents and visitors alike. For touring cyclists riding Salt Spring Island's famously hilly roads, it represents the island's primary public aquatic resource.
